verdict.rationale: Paxos documents programmatic stablecoin sends: a one-call orchestration converts USD to stablecoins and transfers them, API v2 supports asset transfers, and on-chain stablecoin refunds and travel-rule beneficiary data for above-threshold crypto transfers are covered. Status tracking is documented through the Get/List Transfers endpoints for polling, plus orchestration webhooks that fire on each top-level status transition and sub-state change, with retries and a List Events fallback. Missing for 10: an explicit crypto-withdrawal-to-wallet-address endpoint reference, stored crypto recipients/address book (only fiat accounts are evidenced), documented terminal settlement states, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
